caveats: The opinion is unreported and expressly limits its precedential use under Maryland Rule 1-104(a)(2)(B).
Misconduct and refusal-to-hear allegations appearing in the record were not adjudicated as true by the disposition preserved here.

data.title: Yaakov Ezra Vogel v. Benjamin Moshe Vogel, Personal Representative, et al.

evidence.claim: The Appellate Court of Maryland identifies the underlying tribunal as the Rabbinical Court of Cong. Agudath Israel of Los Angeles, records pleaded allegations that the Beth Din refused material evidence and engaged in prejudicial misconduct, and affirms the circuit court judgments resting on the narrower ground that necessary non-signatories had not agreed to arbitrate.
evidence.locator: Appellate Court of Maryland No. 2119, September Term 2023; pp. 1-3, 6-18, 28-30

summary: Official Maryland unreported appellate opinion affirming judgments that treated a Beth Din arbitration agreement as unenforceable/null and void because necessary non-signatories had not agreed to arbitrate; the record also preserves misconduct allegations that were not adjudicated as true.
